vibe: Warm, trustworthy, calming, and high-end. Avoid clinical blues.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl tracking-tight font-medium leading-none text-text_primary

layout_and_spacing.global: Generous spacing. Use p-8 to p-16 for containers. Avoid centering everything.
layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: Use asymmetrical bento layouts for the 3 quick-access cards and services.
layout_and_spacing.hero_section: Asymmetrical layout. Image either gracefully overlapping or given generous breathing room. Use soft glassmorphism for any floating blocks over the image.
layout_and_spacing.surfaces: Soft borders (1px border-border), very light shadow on hover for cards. Rounded corners: rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl.

components_instructions.buttons: Primary buttons: bg-primary text-white rounded-full px-8 py-4 hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform. Accent buttons: bg-accent text-white.
components_instructions.cards: Services cards should be cardless or flat with subtle 1px border. Hover effect: slight lift and shadow-lg.
components_instructions.header: Glassmorphism header: backdrop-blur-xl bg-background_base/70, border-b border-border/40, sticky top-0 z-50.
components_instructions.footer: Deep dark footer: bg-[#2D312E] text-[#FDFBF7] py-20. Large CTA text.
components_instructions.icons: Use lucide-react (thin/light strokes for an elegant feel).
components_instructions.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Textarea. Override generic borders with softer radius.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the theme and colors strictly. Do NOT use default clinical blues (#1B93A4) or purples.
For typography, import Cormorant Garamond and Outfit from Google Fonts.
Do NOT use standard Bootstrap/Shadcn equal-sized cards for everything. Use an asymmetrical Bento Grid for the Quick Access Cards.
Use framer-motion for smooth entrance animations (staggered lists, hover states).
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
The hero image should have a gentle gradient overlay or be placed beautifully on the side to prevent text collisions.
Implement the 'Glassmorphism' effect for the floating navigation bar.
